scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ytriple/source-contract && npm run build --workspace @ytriple/source-service && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @ytriple/source-contract && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @ytriple/source-contract && npm run typecheck --workspace @ytriple/source-service
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @ytriple/source-contract && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && npm run test --workspace @ytriple/source-contract && npm run test --workspace @ytriple/source-service
scripts.source:verify-egress: docker compose -f compose.source.yml exec -T source-worker node services/source-service/dist/verify-egress.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts packages services index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts package.json compose.source.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts packages services index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts package.json compose.source.yml
